caption: The drawing contains two main elements arranged vertically on a cream or light beige background. In the upper part, there is a simple line drawing of a jug or pitcher with a handle on the right side. The jug is outlined in dark blue or black and features a small decorative dark blue motif and some text on its left shoulder area. Below the jug, occupying the lower part of the composition, there is a rectangular patch shaded in a brownish-tan color. Within this patch, there are two distinct features: at the top, the text "S. FAVITTE & CO. UTICA" appears in capital letters, rendered in dark blue; below the text, there is a dark blue ornamental design, possibly floral or abstract, with swirling lines and rounded shapes. The overall drawing uses a limited color palette of cream, brown, and dark blue, with the main focus on the outlined jug and the shaded rectangular section containing text and decoration. The artist's signature is visible in the lower left corner.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
